title: poterium sanguisorba subsp. obscurum
intro: Poterium sanguisorba subsp. obscurum, commonly known as Salad Burnet or Common Burnet, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent properties, which can aid in the relief of digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Poterium sanguisorba subsp. obscurum include acting as a diuretic, reducing fever, and supporting wound healing due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
